title: Interactive viewer: easier and more capable
description: User request. Improve the Qt viewer (qt_viewer.py): scene search/filter, frame-selected/reset camera (F/R keys), view presets (front/side/top/iso), wireframe/normals/UV-checker toggles, shadows and shared PBR shading with the offscreen renderer, node selection highlighting with stats (verts/faces/validation), hot-reload of YAML on file change, screenshot/export buttons, WASD/pan controls, grid+axes.
close_reason: New viewer: orbit camera w/ auto-frame + zoom-to-cursor, view presets, shadows, ground, grid/axes, lit/clay/normals/UV-checker modes, wireframe, picking + tree sync + inspector w/ mesh validation, scene filter, hot reload, screenshot, --viewer-screenshot CLI

title: Export: glTF/GLB with PBR materials, and OBJ
description: There is no way to get assets out for a game engine. Export a SceneNode hierarchy to GLB (node hierarchy preserved, PBR metallic-roughness with baked texture images, normal maps, tangents) and OBJ+MTL. CLI: geogen -s X --export out.glb.
close_reason: geogen/export.py: GLB/glTF with node hierarchy + PBR textures (shared Material.gltf_images), OBJ+MTL; CLI -e/--export; round-trip tests

title: Lathe/revolve generator
description: primitive: lathe. Revolve a 2D (r, y) profile around Y with N segments, optional partial sweep angle, crease-aware normals, cylindrical UVs. Enables turned table/chair legs, vases, balusters, lamp posts, bottles, bowls.
close_reason: core/profile.py (shapes, fillets, splines, offsets, earcut triangulation), generators/profiles.py (ExtrudeGenerator, LatheGenerator), YAML primitives extrude/lathe/ellipsoid; table & chair remodeled with turned legs, filleted tops, spindle back, apron clipping fixed

title: Extrude generator (polygon with holes, optional edge bevel)
description: primitive: extrude. Extrude a 2D profile (with holes) along an axis with caps, optional chamfer/round bevel on cap edges, metric UVs, hard-edge normals. Use for tabletops, panels, window frames, trim, signs.
close_reason: core/profile.py (shapes, fillets, splines, offsets, earcut triangulation), generators/profiles.py (ExtrudeGenerator, LatheGenerator), YAML primitives extrude/lathe/ellipsoid; table & chair remodeled with turned legs, filleted tops, spindle back, apron clipping fixed

title: 2D profile toolkit: polylines, arcs, rounded corners, offset, triangulation with holes
description: Foundation for extrude/lathe/sweep. geogen/geometry2d/ (or core/profile.py): Profile/Shape classes, primitives (rect, rounded rect, circle, polygon, arc, bezier), fillet corners, inset/offset, triangulation with holes (trimesh/earcut/shapely), and YAML-friendly construction.
close_reason: core/profile.py (shapes, fillets, splines, offsets, earcut triangulation), generators/profiles.py (ExtrudeGenerator, LatheGenerator), YAML primitives extrude/lathe/ellipsoid; table & chair remodeled with turned legs, filleted tops, spindle back, apron clipping fixed

title: Mesh processing toolkit: weld, crease-angle normals, tangents, validation
description: Mesh has no utilities beyond transform/merge (and merge drops materials). Add geogen/core/meshops.py: weld_vertices(tol), compute_normals(crease_angle) (smooth within angle, split across hard edges), compute_tangents (for normal maps), validate() reporting degenerate faces, non-manifold edges, open boundaries, inconsistent winding. Generators should emit explicit normals.
close_reason: Implemented: render.py (shadows, PBR maps, --views contact sheet), rounded box replaces broken bevel winding, core/meshops.py with tests

title: Metric UV mapping (box/planar/cylindrical projection, texels per metre)
description: Primitives emit 0-1 UVs per face, so texture density depends on object size (bricks stretch differently on each wall, roofs vs chimney). Add UV projection helpers (box/triplanar-style per-face, planar, cylindrical) parameterised by world units per texture tile, and make generators use metric UVs by default so a brick is the same size everywhere.
close_reason: Metric UVs in all primitives + rooms (core/uvmap.py box/planar/cylindrical), Material.tile_size in metres, renderer+Qt viewer honour it

title: Beveled cube edges render as bright white seams
description: Every beveled cube (chairs, table, house) shows white lines along bevel strips in renders. Likely bevel strip/corner UVs are degenerate (constant v) so they sample the texture edge row, or normals are missing and trimesh averages them. Fix so bevels shade continuous with faces.
close_reason: Implemented: render.py (shadows, PBR maps, --views contact sheet), rounded box replaces broken bevel winding, core/meshops.py with tests

title: Offscreen render quality: shadows, PBR maps, multi-view contact sheet
description: The -r render path (main.py) uses pyrender with no shadows, ignores normal/roughness maps, and renders one fixed view. Judging geometry quality requires: directional shadows, material PBR maps passed through, and a --views option producing a front/side/top/iso contact sheet in one PNG. Extract rendering out of main.py into geogen/render.py so tests and tools can reuse it.
acceptance_criteria: geogen -s X -r out.png --views produces a 2x2 contact sheet with shadows; render code lives in geogen/render.py
close_reason: Implemented: render.py (shadows, PBR maps, --views contact sheet), rounded box replaces broken bevel winding, core/meshops.py with tests

title: High-quality procedural geometry
description: Umbrella for moving geogen from box/cylinder primitives to production-quality procedural geometry for scenery and interiors: solid mesh foundation (normals, UVs, validation), richer modeling operations (extrude/lathe/sweep/booleans/fillets/subdivision), domain generators (roofs, walls with openings, stairs, trees), export (glTF/OBJ, LOD), and a render loop good enough to judge quality.

title: Remodel houses with roof and wall/opening generators
description: Rebuild house_simple/house_peaked with real roofs (closed gables, overhang, fascia), walls with cut openings, framed windows and panelled doors, trim.
close_reason: house_peaked rebuilt (hollow shell, gable roof, gables, chimney) + cottage scene with cut openings; street uses cottages. house_simple (flat roof) left as-is, now unused by street.

title: Remodel furniture with new generators (turned legs, rounded tops, fix table apron clipping)
description: Chair/table use raw boxes and the table apron pokes through the tabletop. Rebuild with lathe legs, rounded-box/extruded tops, proper joinery offsets, and a cushioned seat option.
close_reason: Table & chair remodeled with lathe legs/spindles, filleted extruded tops, apron clipping fixed

title: Geometry QA test suite across all assets
description: Parametrised pytest over every asset/scene: no degenerate faces, no NaNs, normals present and unit length, outward winding for closed parts, UVs present, texel density within bounds, bounding box matches declared size.
close_reason: tests/test_asset_quality.py: validity, metric UVs, non-empty, declared-size fit across all registry scenes

title: Roof generator: gable, hip, shed with overhang, fascia, closed gables
description: house_peaked builds a roof from two rotated cubes, leaving open triangular gable ends and a float-precision seam at the ridge. Add primitive: roof with types gable/hip/shed/flat, pitch, overhang, thickness, fascia board, ridge cap, and gable wall fill piece.
close_reason: core/csg.py (manifold3d, UV-preserving); YAML subtract/cutter and cut_host (placed windows/doors cut openings in the host wall via Surface.source); generators/architecture.py RoofGenerator (gable/hip/shed/flat, overhang, ridge cap, face-planar UVs) + PrismGenerator; window.yaml/door.yaml assets; house_peaked rebuilt as hollow shell; scenes/cottage.yaml; street house plots now use cottages

title: Wall-with-openings generator: windows and doors with frames, mullions, glass, sills
description: Houses currently paste flat boxes on walls. Generate walls with real openings (thickness, reveals), window assemblies (frame profile, mullions/muntins grid, glass pane, sill, lintel) and doors (panelled leaf, frame, handle). Parametric via YAML.
close_reason: core/csg.py (manifold3d, UV-preserving); YAML subtract/cutter and cut_host (placed windows/doors cut openings in the host wall via Surface.source); generators/architecture.py RoofGenerator (gable/hip/shed/flat, overhang, ridge cap, face-planar UVs) + PrismGenerator; window.yaml/door.yaml assets; house_peaked rebuilt as hollow shell; scenes/cottage.yaml; street house plots now use cottages

title: CSG booleans via manifold3d
description: Add union/difference/intersection on Mesh via manifold3d (optional dependency, robust). Exposed in YAML (e.g. part subtract: [other_part]) for cut-outs such as window openings, sink holes, arches.
close_reason: core/csg.py (manifold3d, UV-preserving); YAML subtract/cutter and cut_host (placed windows/doors cut openings in the host wall via Surface.source); generators/architecture.py RoofGenerator (gable/hip/shed/flat, overhang, ridge cap, face-planar UVs) + PrismGenerator; window.yaml/door.yaml assets; house_peaked rebuilt as hollow shell; scenes/cottage.yaml; street house plots now use cottages

title: Rounded box, ellipsoid, torus, capsule primitives
description: Current bevel is a single chamfer; sphere uses min(size) so it cannot be an ellipsoid. Add rounded_box (fillet radius + segments, smooth normals), true ellipsoid scaling for sphere, torus, capsule, and cylinder/cone with bevelled rims.
notes: Done: rounded box (cube bevel+bevel_segments), ellipsoid primitive. Remaining: torus, capsule, beveled cylinder rims (lathe can cover these via profiles).

title: Sweep generator: profile along 3D path
description: primitive: sweep. Sweep a 2D profile along a polyline/bezier path using rotation-minimising frames, with optional caps and scale/twist along path. Use for pipes, railings, cables, crown moldings, baseboards, tree branches, road curbs.

title: Assets declare sizes that don't match their geometry
description: maple_tree, pine_tree, street_lamp use size [scale,scale,scale]=1m but are 1.7-4.8m tall; fire_hydrant declares width 0.3 but outlets make it 0.51 wide. Declared size drives anchors, attachments and framing, so these should declare their true bounds (e.g. a 'scale' param multiplying a real size). Listed in KNOWN_SIZE_MISMATCH in tests/test_asset_quality.py; remove entries as fixed.

title: Wood material: reduce harsh specular hotspot
description: Tabletop renders show a strong sun hotspot in top view. Tune wood roughness map/normalisation in render.py and wood.yaml so varnished wood reads softer.

title: Room walls overlap/stick out at corners
description: In the room scene render, the east wall extends past the adjoining walls at the corner (visible as a protruding slab in iso view). Wall panels should miter or butt cleanly.

title: Materials: glass/transparency, emissive, vertex colors, per-face material groups
description: Windows need glass, lamps need emissive, and multi-material meshes need material groups. Extend Material and viewer/renderer/exporter.
notes: glass, trim_white, door_paint materials added (opaque glass approximation: dark, low roughness, metallic 0.6). Remaining: true transparency/alpha, emissive (lamps), vertex colours, multi-material meshes.

title: Seeded variation and scatter placement (Poisson disk, along paths, on surfaces)
description: Scenes are hand-placed. Add seeded param randomisation (ranges in YAML) and scatter placements: Poisson-disk in region, along path with spacing, on surface with density map, with collision avoidance.

title: Procedural trees and rocks
description: Trees are spheres on cylinders. Build branch skeletons (space colonisation or L-system), sweep branches with tapering, leaf cards/clusters; rocks from displaced subdivided cages.

title: LOD generation via mesh decimation
description: Generate LOD chains (e.g. 100/50/25%) with quadric decimation preserving UV seams and hard edges; export as glTF LOD nodes. Also parametric LOD: generators accept a detail level (segments).

title: Subdivision surfaces (Catmull-Clark/Loop) and displacement
description: Smooth organic forms: subdivide a coarse cage with crease support, plus noise displacement along normals. Use for rocks, cushions, foliage clumps, terrain features.

title: Stairs generator (straight, L, spiral) with railings
description: Parametric stairs: rise/run/width, stringers, treads with nosing, optional railings via sweep. Needed for interiors and multi-storey buildings.
